title: Potato, mushroom and kale tray with baked eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Potatoes, mushrooms, kale, eggs, cheddar, olive oil and spices are all whole, home-kitchen ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board, grater and one roasting tray, with simple roasting and egg-baking technique.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, potatoes get enough time at 220°C to crisp, and eggs baked in gaps for 6 to 8 minutes will set.

honest_times.reason: A quick breakfast was asked for, but the 25 + 10 + 8 minutes in the oven plus 12 minutes' prep comes to nearly an hour, which no busy parent would call quick in the morning.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears beyond the step's shorthand 'paprika' for the listed smoked paprika.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot roast potato and kale breakfast suits mid-February, and the potatoes are clearly the base of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, vegetables, eggs and cheese make a filling, balanced family meal.
